readings.title: The Ordination Ceremony
readings.subtitle: Washing, Anointing, and the Bull of the Sin Offering
readings.text: [Exodus 29:1] <dq>“And this is the task you shall do to them to set them apart to serve <dn>Me</dn> as priests: Take <dn>את</dn> one young bull and <dn>את</dn> two rams, perfect ones,</dq> [2] <dq>and unleavened bread, and unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil – make <dn>את</dn> these of wheat flour.</dq> [3] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> them in one basket and bring <dn>את</dn> them in the basket, along with <dn>את</dn> the bull and <dn>את</dn> the two rams.</dq> [4] <dq>“Then you shall bring <dn>את</dn> Aharon and <dn>את</dn> his sons to the door of the Tent of Appointment, and wash them with water.</dq> [5] <dq>“And you shall take <dn>את</dn> the garments, and shall put on Aharon <dn>את</dn> the long shirt, and <dn>את</dn> the robe of the shoulder garment, and <dn>את</dn> the shoulder garment, and <dn>את</dn> the breastplate, and shall gird him with the embroidered band of the shoulder garment,</dq> [6] <dq>and shall put <dn>את</dn> the turban on his head, and shall put <dn>את</dn> the set-apart sign of dedication on the turban,</dq> [7] <dq>and shall take <dn>את</dn> the anointing oil, and pour it on his head and anoint him.</dq> [8] <dq>“Then you shall bring <dn>את</dn> his sons and put long shirts on them,</dq> [9] <dq>and shall gird them with girdles – Aharon and his sons – and put <dn>את</dn> the turbans on them. And the priesthood shall be theirs for an everlasting law. So you shall ordain <dn>את</dn> Aharon and <dn>את</dn> his sons.</dq> [10] <dq>“And you shall bring near <dn>את</dn> the bull before the Tent of Appointment, and Aharon and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.</dq> [11] <dq>“And you shall slay <dn>את</dn> the bull before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, by the door of the Tent of Appointment,</dq> [12] <dq>and take some of <dn>את</dn> the blood of the bull and put it on <dn>את</dn> the horns of the slaughter-place with your finger, and pour all the blood beside the base of the slaughter-place.</dq> [13] <dq>“And you shall take <dn>את</dn> all the fat that covers the entrails, and <dn>את</dn> the appendage on the liver, and <dn>את</dn> the two kidneys and <dn>את</dn> the fat that is on them, and burn them on the slaughter-place.</dq> [14] <dq>“But <dn>את</dn> the flesh of the bull, and <dn>את</dn> its skin and <dn>את</dn> its dung, you shall burn with fire outside the camp. It is a sin offering.</dq>

readings.title: The Rams of Offering and Ordination
readings.subtitle: The Ascending Offering and the Wave Offering
readings.text: [Exodus 29:15] <dq>“And take <dn>את</dn> one ram, and Aharon and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,</dq> [16] <dq>and you shall slay <dn>את</dn> the ram, and you shall take <dn>את</dn> its blood and sprinkle it all around on the slaughter-place.</dq> [17] <dq>“And cut <dn>את</dn> the ram in pieces, and wash <dn>את</dn> its entrails and <dn>את</dn> its legs, and place them upon its pieces and on its head.</dq> [18] <dq>“And you shall burn <dn>את</dn> the entire ram on the slaughter-place. It is an ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, it is a sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [19] <dq>“And you shall take <dn>את</dn> the second ram, and Aharon and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,</dq> [20] <dq>and you shall slay <dn>את</dn> the ram, and take some of <dn>את</dn> its blood and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aharon and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood all around on the slaughter-place.</dq> [21] <dq>“And you shall take some of <dn>את</dn> the blood that is on the slaughter-place, and some of <dn>את</dn> the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aharon and on his garments, on his sons and on the garments of his sons with him. And he and his garments shall be set-apart, and his sons and the garments of his sons with him.</dq> [22] <dq>“And you shall take <dn>את</dn> the fat of the ram, and <dn>את</dn> the fat tail, and <dn>את</dn> the fat that covers the entrails, and <dn>את</dn> the appendage on the liver, and <dn>את</dn> the two kidneys and <dn>את</dn> the fat on them, and <dn>את</dn> the right thigh – it is for a ram of ordination –</dq> [23] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> one loaf of bread, and <dn>את</dn> one cake made with oil, and <dn>את</dn> one thin cake from the basket of the unleavened bread that is before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [24] <dq>“And you shall put all these in the hands of Aharon and in the hands of his sons, and you shall wave them – a wave offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [25] <dq>“Then you shall take them from their hands and burn them on the slaughter-place as an ascending offering, as a sweet fragrance before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. It is an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall take <dn>את</dn> the breast of the ram of Aharon’s ordination and wave it – a wave offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and it shall be your portion.</dq> [27] <dq>“And from the ram of ordination you shall set apart <dn>את</dn> the breast of the wave offering which is waved, and <dn>את</dn> the thigh of the contribution which is raised, of that which is for Aharon and of that which is for his sons.</dq> [28] <dq>“And it shall be from <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl for Aharon and his sons by a law forever, for it is a contribution. And it is a contribution from the children of Yisra’ěl from <dn>את</dn> the slaughters of their peace offerings – <dn>את</dn> their contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: The Seven-Day Ordinance
readings.subtitle: Sanctifying the Priests and the Altar
readings.text: [Exodus 29:29] <dq>“And <dn>את</dn> the set-apart garments of Aharon are for his sons after him, to be anointed in them and to be ordained in them.</dq> [30] <dq>“The priest from his sons in his place, puts them on for seven days, when he enters the Tent of Appointment to attend in the set-apart place.</dq> [31] <dq>“And take <dn>את</dn> the ram of ordination and cook its flesh in a set-apart place.</dq> [32] <dq>“And Aharon and his sons shall eat <dn>את</dn> the flesh of the ram, and <dn>את</dn> the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the Tent of Appointment,</dq> [33] <dq>and they shall eat <dn>את</dn> those offerings with which the atonement was made, to ordain them, to set them apart. But let a stranger not eat them, because they are set-apart.</dq> [34] <dq>“And if any of the flesh of the ordination offerings, or of the bread, be left over until the morning, then you shall burn up <dn>את</dn> what is left over. It is not eaten, because it is set-apart.</dq> [35] <dq>“And so you shall do to Aharon and his sons, according to all <dn>I</dn> have commanded you. Seven days you shall ordain them,</dq> [36] <dq>and prepare <dn>את</dn> a bull each day as a sin offering for atonement. And you shall cleanse <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place when you make atonement for it, and you shall anoint <dn>את</dn> it to set it apart.</dq> [37] <dq>“For seven days you shall make atonement for <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place, and set <dn>את</dn> it apart. And <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place shall be most set-apart – <dn>את</dn> whatever touches <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place is to be set-apart.</dq>

readings.title: The Continual Offering
readings.subtitle: The Promise of His Dwelling Presence
readings.text: [Exodus 29:38] <dq>“And this is <dn>את</dn> what you prepare on the slaughter-place: <dn>את</dn> two lambs, a year old, daily, continually.</dq> [39] <dq>“Prepare <dn>את</dn> the one lamb in the morning, and <dn>את</dn> the other lamb you prepare between the evenings,</dq> [40] <dq>and one-tenth of an ěphah of flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil, and one-fourth of a hin of wine as a drink offering, with the one lamb.</dq> [41] <dq>“And prepare <dn>את</dn> the other lamb between the evenings. And with it prepare <dn>את</dn> the grain offering and <dn>את</dn> the drink offering, as in the morning, for a sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> –</dq> [42] <dq>a continual ascending offering for your generations at the door of the Tent of Appointment before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, where <dn>I</dn> shall meet with you to speak with you.</dq> [43] <dq>“And there <dn>I</dn> shall meet with the children of Yisra’ěl, and it shall be set apart by <dn>My</dn> esteem.</dq> [44] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall set apart <dn>את</dn> the Tent of Appointment and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place. And <dn>את</dn> Aharon and <dn>את</dn> his sons <dn>I</dn> set apart to serve as priests to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [45] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall dwell in the midst of the children of Yisra’ěl and shall be their <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [46] <dq>“And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn>, who brought them up out of the land of Mitsrayim, to dwell in their midst. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: The Altar of Incense
readings.subtitle: Its Construction and Daily Atonement
readings.text: [Exodus 30:1] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> a slaughter-place to burn incense on, make <dn>את</dn> it of acacia wood,</dq> [2] <dq>a cubit long and a cubit wide – it is a square – and two cubits high, its horns of the same.</dq> [3] <dq>“And you shall overlay <dn>את</dn> its top, and <dn>את</dn> its sides all around, and <dn>את</dn> its horns with clean gold. And you shall make for it <dn>את</dn> a moulding of gold all around.</dq> [4] <dq>“And make two gold rings for it, under the moulding on both its sides. Make them on its two sides, and they shall be holders for the poles to lift it with.</dq> [5] <dq>“And you shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.</dq> [6] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> it before the veil that is before the ark of the Witness, before <dn>את</dn> the lid of atonement that is over <dn>את</dn> the Witness, where <dn>I</dn> am to meet with you.</dq> [7] <dq>“And Aharon shall burn on it sweet incense, morning by morning. As he tends the lamps, he shall burn incense on it.</dq> [8] <dq>“And when Aharon lights the lamps between the evenings, he shall burn incense on it – a continual incense before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> throughout your generations.</dq> [9] <dq>“Do not offer strange incense on it, or an ascending offering, or a grain offering, and do not pour a drink offering on it.</dq> [10] <dq>“And Aharon shall make atonement upon its horns once a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonement – once a year he makes atonement upon it throughout your generations. It is most set-apart to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: Atonement and Purification
readings.subtitle: The Census Ransom and the Bronze Basin for Washing
readings.text: [Exodus 30:11] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [12] <dq>“When you take <dn>את</dn> the census of the children of Yisra’ěl, to register them, then each one shall give an atonement for his life to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when you register them, so that there is no plague among them when you register them.</dq> [13] <dq>“Everyone among those who are registered is to give this: half a sheqel according to the sheqel of the set-apart place, twenty gěrahs being a sheqel. The half-sheqel is the contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [14] <dq>“Everyone passing over to be registered, from twenty years old and above, gives a contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [15] <dq>“The rich does not give more and the poor does not give less than half a sheqel, when you give a contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to make atonement for yourselves.</dq> [16] <dq>“And you shall take <dn>את</dn> the silver for the atonement from <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl, and give <dn>את</dn> it for the service of the Tent of Appointment. And it shall be to the children of Yisra’ěl for a remembrance before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to make atonement for yourselves.”</dq> [17] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [18] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> a basin of bronze, with <dn>את</dn> its stand also of bronze, for washing. And you shall put <dn>את</dn> it between the Tent of Appointment and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place, and shall put <dn>את</dn> water in it.</dq> [19] <dq>“And Aharon and his sons shall wash from it their hands and their feet.</dq> [20] <dq>“When they go into the Tent of Appointment, or when they come near the slaughter-place to attend, to burn an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, they wash with water, lest they die.</dq> [21] <dq>“And they shall wash their hands and their feet, lest they die. And it shall be a law forever to them, to him and his seed throughout their generations.”</dq>

readings.title: The Anointing Oil and Holy Incense
readings.subtitle: Their Composition and Exclusive Use
readings.text: [Exodus 30:22] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [23] <dq>“And take for yourself choice spices, five hundred sheqels of liquid myrrh, and half as much – two hundred and fifty – of sweet-smelling cinnamon, and two hundred and fifty of sweet-smelling cane,</dq> [24] <dq>and five hundred of cassia, according to the sheqel of the set-apart place, and a hin of olive oil.</dq> [25] <dq>“And you shall make from these a set-apart anointing oil, a compound, blended, the work of a perfumer. It is a set-apart anointing oil.</dq> [26] <dq>“And with it you shall anoint <dn>את</dn> the Tent of Appointment and <dn>את</dn> the ark of the Witness,</dq> [27] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the table and <dn>את</dn> all its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the lampstand and <dn>את</dn> its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of incense,</dq> [28] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of ascending offering with <dn>את</dn> all its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the basin and <dn>את</dn> its stand.</dq> [29] <dq>“And you shall set them apart, and they shall be most set-apart. Whatever touches them is to be set-apart.</dq> [30] <dq>“And you shall anoint <dn>את</dn> Aharon and <dn>את</dn> his sons, and set <dn>את</dn> them apart, to serve as priests to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [31] <dq>“And speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, saying, ‘This is a set-apart anointing oil to <dn>Me</dn> throughout your generations.</dq> [32] <dq>‘It shall not be poured on the flesh of a man, and make no other like it, according to its composition. It is set-apart, it is set-apart to you.</dq> [33] <dq>‘Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, shall be cut off from his people.’ ”</dq> [34] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Take <dn>את</dn> sweet spices, <dn>את</dn> fragrant gum and <dn>את</dn> cinnamon and <dn>את</dn> galbanam, and <dn>את</dn> clear frankincense with <dn>את</dn> these sweet spices, all in equal amounts.</dq> [35] <dq>“Then you shall make of these an incense, a compound, work of a perfumer, salted, clean, set-apart.</dq> [36] <dq>“And you shall beat some of it very fine, and put some of it before the Witness in the Tent of Appointment where <dn>I</dn> meet with you, it is most set-apart to you.</dq> [37] <dq>“And <dn>את</dn> the incense which you make, do not make any for yourselves, according to its composition, it is set-apart to you for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [38] <dq>“Whoever makes any like it, to smell it, he shall be cut off from his people.”</dq>

readings.title: The Spirit-Filled Artisans
readings.subtitle: Bezalel and Oholiab Appointed to Build the Dwelling Place
readings.text: [Exodus 31:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> have called by name Betsal’ěl son of Uri, son of Ḥur, of the tribe of Yehuḏah,</dq> [3] <dq>and <dn>I</dn> have filled him with the Spirit of <dn>Elohim</dn> in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all work,</dq> [4] <dq>to make designs for work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,</dq> [5] <dq>and in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, and to work in all work.</dq> [6] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn>, look <dn>I</dn> have appointed with him <dn>את</dn> Oholiaḇ son of Aḥisamaḵ, of the tribe of Dan And <dn>I</dn> have put wisdom in the hearts of everyone who is wise-hearted, and they shall make all that <dn>I</dn> have commanded you:</dq> [7] <dq><dn>את</dn> the Tent of Appointment, and <dn>את</dn> the ark of the Witness and <dn>את</dn> the lid of atonement that is on it, and <dn>את</dn> all the utensils of the Tent,</dq> [8] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the table and <dn>את</dn> its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the clean gold lampstand with <dn>את</dn> all its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of incense,</dq> [9] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of ascending offering with <dn>את</dn> all its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the basin and <dn>את</dn> its stand,</dq> [10] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the woven garments, and <dn>את</dn> the set-apart garments for Aharon the priest and <dn>את</dn> the garments of his sons, for serving as priests,</dq> [11] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the anointing oil and <dn>את</dn> sweet incense for the Set-apart Place. According to all that <dn>I</dn> have commanded you, they are to do.”</dq>

readings.title: The Sabbath Commandment
readings.subtitle: A Perpetual Sign and the Tablets of Stone
readings.text: [Exodus 31:12] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [13] <dq>“And you, speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, saying, ‘<dn>My</dn> Sabbaths you are to guard, by all means, for it is a sign between <dn>Me</dn> and you throughout your generations, to know that <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, am setting you apart.</dq> [14] <dq>‘And you shall guard <dn>את</dn> the Sabbath, for it is set-apart to you. Everyone who profanes it shall certainly be put to death, for anyone who does work on it, that being shall be cut off from among his people.</dq> [15] <dq>‘Six days work is done, and on the seventh is a Sabbath of rest, set-apart to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. Everyone doing work on the Sabbath day shall certainly be put to death.</dq> [16] <dq>‘And the children of Yisra’ěl shall guard <dn>את</dn> the Sabbath, to perform <dn>את</dn> the Sabbath throughout their generations as an everlasting covenant.</dq> [17] <dq>‘Between <dn>Me</dn> and the children of Yisra’ěl it is a sign forever. For in six days <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> made <dn>את</dn> the heavens and <dn>את</dn> the earth, and on the seventh day <dn>He</dn> rested and was refreshed.’ ”</dq> [18] And when <dn>He</dn> had ended speaking with him on Mount Sinai, <dn>He</dn> gave Mosheh <dn>את</dn> two tablets of the Witness, tablets of stone, written with the finger of <dn>Elohim</dn>.
